points: Over 600,000 industrial robots installed in 2025 (+11%); operational stock up 9% to 5 million
China installed 354,000 units, about 59% of the world; Germany fifth with under 25,000 (-8%) but 41% of EU installs
read: IFR press release on World Robotics 2026, Frankfurt, 24 September 2026
take: Hard baseline for automation plans: installations grow 11% globally, driven by China, while German robot sales fall 8%. Useful benchmark against humanoid hype.
title: IFR World Robotics 2026: five million factory robots, Germany slips
